// DESIGN PSEUDOCODE ONLY. Not compiled; none of these APIs are published grea APIs.
// Newly authored synthetic example. No original game source or formulas.
// Scope: one writer, one aggregate snapshot, explicit recovery of unknown commits.

ClaimResult Claim(ClaimRequest request, VerifiedCapabilityResult capability)
{
    // Input is typed and validated. A Boolean from a UI is not proof of an ad.
    // Demo capability results are permitted only by an explicit QA profile.
    using var lease = store.EnterSingleWriter();
    var state = store.ReadValidatedAggregate(); // Corrupt/schema/IO must not become Missing.

    var prior = state.Operations.Find(request.OperationId);
    if (prior != null)
        return prior.RequestDigest == request.Digest
            ? ClaimResult.Replayed(prior.Receipt)
            : ClaimResult.Conflict("OperationId reused with different input");

    if (state.ClaimKeys.Contains(request.ClaimKey))
        return ClaimResult.AlreadyClaimed(state.ReceiptFor(request.ClaimKey));
    if (state.Revision != request.ExpectedRevision)
        return ClaimResult.StaleState();

    var definition = catalog.Require(request.RewardDefinitionId);
    // Check reward eligibility, configured capability, limits, costs and ranges.
    // UI route names, visibility or a previous Show() call never grant eligibility.
    var validation = rules.Validate(state, request, capability, definition);
    if (!validation.Allowed)
        return ClaimResult.Rejected(validation.Reason);

    var next = state.Copy();
    var receipt = rules.ApplyToCopy(next, request, definition);
    next.Operations.Add(request.OperationId, request.Digest, receipt);
    next.ClaimKeys.Add(request.ClaimKey, receipt.Id);
    next.Revision++;

    // State, inventory, limit counters and receipt commit together.
    // This transactional store is a design requirement, not FileSaveStore's current API.
    var commit = store.CommitIfCurrent(state.Revision, next);
    if (commit == CommitStatus.Unknown)
        return ClaimResult.PendingRecovery(request.OperationId); // Query same ID; never regrant.
    if (commit != CommitStatus.Committed)
        return ClaimResult.SaveFailed();
    return ClaimResult.Committed(receipt);
}

// Presenter sketch: the PlayerScope owns the business operation; a ViewScope
// owns only UI subscriptions, async rendering and resource handles.
async Task ShowClaimResult(ClaimRequest request, ViewBinding binding)
{
    var generation = binding.Generation;
    var result = await playerOperations.SubmitOrQuery(request);
    if (!binding.IsAlive || binding.Generation != generation)
        return; // A new view can query the same receipt later.
    view.Render(result); // Render never mutates inventory or marks claimed.
}
